goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, save a memo, and navigate the calendar to view the previous month.

findings.instruction: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
findings.title: Dashboard layout is severely broken with overlapping and duplicated elements
findings.description: After successful account creation and navigation to the dashboard, the UI is in a broken state. The calendar widget appears duplicated and semi-transparent, overlapping with other content. The layout is misaligned, with elements pushed off-screen or rendered incorrectly, making the interface unusable.
findings.evidence: The AFTER screenshot shows a distorted dashboard where the 'June 2026' calendar is rendered twice with transparency, overlapping the 'Shortcuts' and 'Tags' sections. The overall layout is not aligned to a proper grid, and content appears clipped or misplaced.
reproduction_steps: Navigate to the 'Create your account' page.
